name: Human project owners create and edit requirements drafts
summary: In simple mode a signed-in project owner creates requirement or narrative drafts under an existing task and edits accepted text while preserving history. Current session, owner membership and revision/hash checks gate writes; machine credentials and non-owner superusers gain no authority. Contributors cannot replace a validated human pending owner draft, including interrupted retries; they propose a change. Governed and host operator policies remain unchanged. Only the original owner can clear a validated pending revision-1 create with no allocated native row, under current locks and an exact receipt hash. The receipt and audit remain; released identities cannot allocate again. Recovery lists at most 20 items with exact listed, total and truncated fields, sharing one complete validated export and native membership read per request. Damaged receipts are isolated, recovery errors hide server paths and panel failure leaves the requirements document usable.
